title: Unit – 2 : Session – 5 : SLO – 2 | Method Definition Errors
sections: Code 1: public int printHello() { System.out.println("Hello"); } — MISTAKE: declared return type int but returns nothing. FIX: public void printHello() { System.out.println("Hello"); }  REASON: a non-void method must return a value; the method only prints, so void is correct.

Code 2: void calculateSum(int a, b) { return a + b; } — MISTAKES: parameter b lacks a type, and a void method cannot return a value. FIX: int calculateSum(int a, int b) { return a + b; }  REASON: every parameter needs its own type; to return the sum the return type must be int.

Code 3: int private multiply(int x, int y) { return x * y; } — MISTAKE: access modifier written after the return type. FIX: private int multiply(int x, int y) { return x * y; }  REASON: Java syntax order is: modifiers first, then return type, then method name.
